mapper.insert: insert into clazz (name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, subject,update_time) values (#{name}, #{room}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{masterId}, #{subject}, now())
mapper.select: select c.*, e.name as master_name from clazz c left join emp e on c.master_id=e.id where c.id=#{id}
mapper.update:
update clazz
name = #{name},
room = #{room},
begin_date = #{beginDate},
end_date = #{endDate},
master_id = #{masterId},
subject = #{subject},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select c.name as pos, Count(s.id) as num from clazz c left join student s on s.clazz_id=c.id group by c.id order by num
